d.t: AnchorFix tool to eliminate air voids in resin
d.s: Sika AnchorFix Resin Stoppers is a tool for filling deep and / or large diameter drilled holes by eliminating air voids. It is used with a Sika Anchorfix flexible tube which is fixed onto the static mixer.
a: Diameter options for all drill hole sizes
Prevents air voids in drill holes
us: Eliminating air voids in deep and / or large diameter drilled holes
d.pk: Resin Stoppers Bag of 1 piece / diameter Bag of 10 pieces / diameter Bag of 6 pieces with one piece per diameter: 18–50 mm (set)

sec.t: Resin stoppers are referenced in the corresponding approvals of each Sika AnchorFix product
5 years from the date of production
The product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +35 °C. Always refer to packaging.
